description: Per-entrypoint Soroban budget thresholds for the resolution contract gas snapshot tests. Each entry records the maximum allowed CPU instructions and memory bytes for one entrypoint path, measured against the mock-host budget with an unlimited reset immediately before the call. Tests apply a 5% ceiling on top of these values before asserting, so an SDK update that raises costs by less than 5% will not fail CI. To update a threshold after an intentional cost increase, raise the value here and document the reason in the commit message.
